_comment: Mutation testing for the SECURITY-CRITICAL libs only (access control, download-token signing, citation extraction). These are the modules where a test suite that merely *executes* lines without *asserting* behavior is dangerous, so we pay the mutation-testing cost here and nowhere else. Deliberately NOT a merge gate — run on demand via `npm run test:mutation` or the monthly mutation.yml workflow. Floors only go up: when tests kill more mutants, raise thresholds.break in the same PR. Widen mutate only alongside tests that keep the score above the floor.
